Donald Trump's popularity rebounded slightly in this week's Economist / YouGov Poll after his recent slump, but he remains deeply unpopular. This week's poll finds that 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, and 57% disapprove — a net job approval of -21. That's an improvement for Trump from the week before, when 35% approved and 61% disapproved for a net approval of -26. Two weeks ago, Trump hit the lowest job approval numbers of either of his terms: 33% [...] Among the 19% of registered voters who somewhat approve of Trump, 66% say they'll definitely vote in November. Among the 9% who somewhat disapprove of Trump, only 59% say they'll definitely vote.
